extras.textures: PBR 2048px: base color, roughness, metallic, normal (baked)
extras.real_size: car transporter semi (cab-over tractor + two-deck trailer) with two small cars, approx. 16.3 x 2.6 x 4.2 m (L x W x H), wheel diameter 0.96 m
extras.notes: front faces -Y; the trailer 'car-transporter_trailer' (incl. the rear cargo car) is a separate object with its origin on the kingpin (rotate around local Z to articulate); its 4 wheel objects are children of the trailer; 8 wheels are separate objects with origin on the axle (rotate around local X to roll), the 2 front wheels can also steer; the cargo cars are static; translucent cab windows with seats, dashboard and steering wheel; no brand, no text

origin.detail: Built procedurally with Blender scripts. The scripts were written with the help of an AI coding assistant. No generative AI model produced the geometry or textures directly.
